1934, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 183 Cont.
Mar. 29 Theresa Schneid Cont. - Her sister, Mrs. Schlaf, who lives in Detroit, asks for prayers that operation be averted. Theresa most remarkable for patience & faith, brave and zealous ....
30 Mrs. Susan Tittensor - 55 - Presbiterian, very sick with asthma - hardly expected to live till morning .... Enrolled at 10 p.m. March 23 - was better when son got home ... Enrolled To-night perpetually.
Page 183
1934, April
April 1 Edith Hartman - 21 - mental ... Rec. Hospit. three weeks
Jewel Frby - 19 mo. - bones wanting in strength
2 Wm. Peltier - 8 - had infantile p. two years ago. Since last Sep- tember has not been able to walk at all - enrolled To-day for year promising .....
Mrs. Nollie - 52 - Ironwood - Epileptic 14 yrs. Fred Yokom - 14 - Baptist of Windsor - Epileptic now 4 yrs. Miss Lanallen - 19 - nervous Break. Sister Henrietta - cancer threatened.
Page 184 April Sister Alphonsa - Elderly - losing sight and like paralysed ... Jerry Garland
Frank Denomy - 55 - wife & 10 - very sick in Grace Hosp .... Corine Bondy - Windsor - phoned - Financial desperation? Mrs. Ivo. Wiggins - Husband and son - Chatham Mrs. Trombley 40 yrs married - Today lost $10. coming this P.M. ... daughter gave her.
Monseign. McCarthy - 2 strokes
Page 185 April 5 Nancy Louis - 3 - trouble doubtful, but not really well ..
. . .
